# Portugal

[global-law](../) / Portugal

3 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 2 legislation, subdivisions). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 40% (estimate, low confidence, 32.3–52.5%) | 100% | 0% |

Broad national record: 2,101 acts, which is every Lei and Decreto-Lei the Diário da República (DR) marks in force and has a consolidated text for (2,098), plus the Constitution and the Civil and Labour Codes. Every essential is held, but 1,697 acts are current text only. For 304 acts, including the Civil Procedure Code, the Criminal Procedure Code and the CPA, that current 2026 text is dated to the act's publication day, so a reader asking for an earlier date gets the wrong text. Both autonomous regions are held, but only the regional decrees the DR consolidates (133 and 116 acts). No case law is held.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
